evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Perform data cleaning, validation, and testing to ensure data quality and reliability
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Responsibilities repeatedly emphasize data quality, validation, and testing ('data cleaning, validation, and testing', 'deploy and test analytical datasets') with no velocity/speed language, driving a rigour classification.
evidence.domain_risk: focusing on transforming, modeling, and delivering high-quality business data for analytics and reporting
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: The role feeds executive reporting and dashboards for business decisions but there is no financial/regulatory/compliance language, placing it at moderate risk.
evidence.data_team_maturity: Build and manage data transformation pipelines following ELT best practices
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: Named tools/practices (ELT pipelines, semantic layers, BI tools) appear directly in responsibilities, indicating an existing, growing data function rather than a greenfield build.
evidence.jd_authorship: Design, develop, and maintain KPI dashboards and executive reporting solutions, including metric calculation frameworks and data visualization
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Responsibilities are specific and concrete (KPI dashboards, metric calculation frameworks, ELT pipelines, semantic layers) letting the reader understand the day-to-day work.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Support and optimize BI tools and semantic layers
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: The role's output serves the internal data/BI function itself (dashboards, semantic layers, data models) rather than a specific commercial, product, or finance team.
evidence.autonomy_level: Collaborate closely with business stakeholders to understand reporting and analytics needs
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: Verbs are support/delivery oriented ('collaborate', 'support', 'contribute to') rather than direction-setting, placing this at execution level.
evidence.ai_role_explanation: No mention of AI tools for the candidate's own workflow or AI-consuming data infrastructure anywhere in the JD.
evidence.testing_framing: Hands-on experience with data cleaning, validation, and testing
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Testing appears as a required skill/experience item in qualifications and responsibilities, without an explicit ownership/definition framing, so it is tool_listed rather than responsibility.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing: Perform data cleaning, validation, and testing to ensure data quality and reliability
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: Data quality and reliability are named concerns but framed as delivery tasks rather than a dominant compliance/trust risk register, placing this at moderate.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Build and manage data transformation pipelines following ELT best practices
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: The role extends and maintains existing pipelines, dashboards, and BI tooling rather than building new infrastructure from scratch.
evidence.language_gate: Good level of English (written and spoken)
evidence.loss_aversion: Perform data cleaning, validation, and testing to ensure data quality and reliability — quality is framed as an operational deliverable, not a stated business/regulatory risk.
